# What We Have

TIRS_SINAVE_22_23 shapefile includes (?)

- .dbf file: contains attribute table

- .shp file: contains track outlines

- .shx file: connective tissue to link it all together

- .prj file: for map projection

- .cpg file: used to specify the code page to identify character encoding

Also have the cluster shapefile! (From David, actual lifesaver)

# What I'd Like to do
Plot and see at what level cases are clustering -- household? block? cluster?

# Data

Load libraries
```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, #replaces "maptools", "rgdal" and other deprecated packages 
               # tmap, #helps with plotting your map
               # RColorBrewer, # creates nice color schemes
               # classInt,  # finds class intervals for continuous variables
               # spgwr, # Adds the geographically weighted regression functions
               here, # For constructing filepaths relative to root directory
               tidyverse
               )
```

Read in shapefiles
```{r}
## Read in case shapefile - TIRS_SINAVE_22_23
cases <- st_read(dsn = here("data"), 
                 layer = "TIRS_SINAVE_22_23")
## Cluster shapefile
clusters <- st_read(dsn = here("data"),
                    layer = "Cluster final 2021 actualizado")
```

# Cluster Map

## Plot Only Clusters
```{r}
plot(clusters['CLUSTER'],
     col = adjustcolor("grey", alpha=0.5),
     lwd = 0.3)
```

## Plot by TIRS Arm
```{r}
plot(clusters['TIRS'],
     pal = c("tomato", "darkolivegreen2"),
     lwd = 0.3)
```

# Cases Map (by Year)
```{r}
plot(cases["Year"],
     pal = c("pink", "cadetblue3"))
```

Finding limits for zooming in:
```{r}
print(clusters, n = 2)
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
  #geom_sf(data = clusters, linewidth = 0.1, aes(fill = as.factor(TIRS))) +
  geom_sf(data = clusters, aes(color = as.factor("MZCODE"))) +
  geom_sf(data = cases, size = 1,
          aes(color = as.factor(Year))) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato", "darkolivegreen2"), 
  #                   name = "TIRS", labels = c("No", "Yes")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "lightblue", "navy"), 
                    name = "Year", labels = c("2022", "2023", "houses")) +
 # coord_sf(xlim = c(-42, 52), ylim = c(12, 84)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# ggplot

## Full Map
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = clusters, linewidth = 0.1, aes(fill = as.factor(TIRS))) +
  geom_sf(data = cases, size = 1,
          aes(color = as.factor(Year))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato", "darkolivegreen2"), 
                    name = "TIRS", labels = c("No", "Yes")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("lightblue", "navy"), 
                    name = "Year", labels = c("2022", "2023")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
